ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider (as a Ryde voucher per NS-7), and record the driver's unmet "I'm Here"/3-minute wait conditions for account monitoring.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver states he 'waited more than 3 minutes' before cancelling as a no-show; the system timeline (I'm Here 14:13:10, cancel 14:14:50 = 1 min 40 s) and the GPS trace (stationary within ~5 m of pickup only from 14:13:00) contradict this, and system records override statements. His own 14:14:40 chat repeating the 3-minute claim is likewise unsupported.
